# NE Structures

> Leading Manufacturer of Pre-Engineered Buildings & High-Rise Steel Structures in India.

NE Structures provides turnkey engineering, fabrication, and erection solutions for industrial, commercial, and infrastructure steel structures. State-of-the-art manufacturing facility based in Bangalore.

## Products
- [Pre-Engineered Buildings](https://www.nestructures.in/PreEngineeredBuildings): Custom industrial sheds, warehouses, and factory buildings.
- [High-Rise Steel Structures](https://www.nestructures.in/HighRiseSteelStructures): Heavy structural steel frames for multi-storey and commercial high-rises.
- [Roofing Sheets](https://www.nestructures.in/RoofingSheets): Premium color-coated galvalume and corrugated roofing sheets.
- [CZ Purlins](https://www.nestructures.in/CZPurlins): High-tensile cold-rolled C and Z purlins.

## Services
- [Structural Engineering Services](https://www.nestructures.in/StructuralEngineeringServices): Complete design, load analysis, and engineering.
- [Building Information Modelling](https://www.nestructures.in/BuildingInformationModelling): Advanced 3D BIM modelling and detailing.
